text:
sachin: quick check — prepping a llamaX-14B rollout. two things: (1) canonical weights + config location, (2) quantization plan (awq vs fp8) and calibration size. putting notes here so we have a paper trail.

maria: weights are at s3://redwood-models/llamaX/14B/v1/weights.tar.gz — that’s the snap we validated on perf tests last week. config is s3://redwood-models/llamaX/14B/v1/config.json. use the config from that path exactly for serving to avoid tokenizer/config drift.

devin: re: tokenizer quirk — we saw the leading-newline tokenization before. short workaround: set `tokenizer.add_prefix_space=True` when using the fast tokenizer, or run this conversion once during onboarding:```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
# normalize newlines consistently
# export huggingface style
```
Long term we should normalize training/serving text pipeline.

priya: for quantization — quick summary from experiments: AWQ-int8 gives ~1.2-1.6x speedup vs fp16 with ~0.5-1.5% LM metric drop depending on prompts. FP8 (hardware fp8 sim) can hit similar throughput to awq in some kernels but is noisier for long-context.

maria: calibration dataset proposal: 5k examples balanced across prompt lengths (short/med/long) and tasks (summ, conv, extraction). devin suggested 2k as minimal for AWQ to stabilize per-layer scales. i think 5k is safer for production.

devin: fwiw, for AWQ we saw diminishing returns after ~3k calibration examples for the small eval set; if you’re time-constrained 3k is a pragmatic default. for fp8 calibration we need more diverse cal data and per-tensor stats — plan for 5k+.

priya: approval criteria idea: regression <= 1% relative on LM perplexity and <= 2% on our ROUGE/QA micro metrics vs fp16 baseline. also require smoke-run of 1000 production-ish prompts with KV caching to check decoding stability. anyone object?

maria: sounds good. add a note to the rollout checklist about tokenization normalization and config pinning.

devin: commands i ran for calibration (for reference):```bash
python infra/quant/calibrate.py --model-path s3://redwood-models/llamaX/14B/v1 --method awq --calib-size 3000 --out-dir /tmp/awq_calib
python infra/quant/calibrate.py --model-path s3://redwood-models/llamaX/14B/v1 --method fp8 --calib-size 5000 --out-dir /tmp/fp8_calib
```

sachin: thanks all. decision for now: run AWQ with calib_size=3000 as a quick gate, run FP8 full 5k sweep in parallel. priya — can you sign off on the acceptance criteria after you see the AWQ numbers?

priya: yep i'll check AWQ metrics when devin uploads them, target is to approve if <=1% perplexity regression and smoke-run passes. :thumbsup:
